text:
marco (design): Quick sync: proposal for a compressed latency header that surfaces presets + a collapsed sampling control. Goal: free vertical space for the heatmap and keep p95 visible. Presets: 20s / 1m / 5m / 30m. Sampling pill expands to a micro-slider. Mock: https://figma.com/file/compact-latency anya (frontend): I like the compressed approach. Two implementation asks: (1) show a tiny indicator on the sampling pill when it's non-default (dot or short %), (2) expand as an overlay to avoid reflow on the chart. drew (eng): Backend constraints: sampling changes the aggregation pipeline. Please include sampling_pct in the route (`?sampling_pct=20`) so cached endpoints match. Also debounce slider updates (200ms). We'll expose a small p95 endpoint so the client can fetch p95 independently. sasha (pm): Product stance: default sampling 25% for most orgs. Presets must be tappable and keyboard reachable. We'll instrument preset_click and sampling_change events to tune defaults. Keep p95 pinned and tappable to open the distribution drawer. noel (a11y): A11y checklist highlights: presets must be focusable and announced (role=listbox or tablist), sampling pill must expose `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, slider needs `aria-valuetext` like "Sampling: 25%", and chart updates should be announced via `aria-live` polite with a concise message e.g., "Latency chart updated to 1 minute range". Also the small legend chips on dark theme fail contrast at 12px; bump or increase size. marco (design): Copy suggestion for the sampling tooltip: "Sampling reduces processing and storage; may hide short spikes." Short and concrete. We'll also show a low-density overlay when sampling <=5% with badge "low sampling — expect noise" and a subtle hatch pattern for colorblind support. anya (frontend): Implementation sketch: ```
[20s][1m][5m][30m]
p95: 140ms
``` Panel contains `` with `aria-valuetext="Sampling: 25%"`. We'll debounce requests and update the URL with the sampling param. drew (eng): Agreed. We'll add `latency_sampling_change` and `timebar_preset_click` telemetry events. Server will compute p95 on range change and cache for 1s to avoid thrash. Keeping p95 separate reduces client rendering cost. sasha (pm): Decision: ship v1 with compressed toolbar, presets, custom modal, collapsed sampling pill (default 25%), pinned p95. Follow-ups: noel to deliver A11y checklist, anya to prototype the overlay/animation, drew to add query param + telemetry, marco to polish copy and low-density visual. event-bot: Note: telemetry event `timebar_preset_click` recorded for marco at 1986543225 noel (a11y): I'll post the checklist this afternoon: focus order, roles for presets, aria-live phrasing, keyboard flow for custom modal, slider aria text, tooltip dismissible via Escape, and contrast targets. anya (frontend): I'll prototype the collapsed pill with overlay expand + low-density badge by Friday. Will include keyboard interactions and the small dot indicator for non-default sampling. marco (design): Thanks team — will iterate mocks with contrast fixes and bring copy option A (above) to UX sync. :white_check_mark:
